mcqs.question: What is a database schema?
options: The overall description of the structure of the database
The data stored in the database at a particular moment
A set of SQL queries stored in the database
A backup copy of the database

mcqs.question: The collection of data stored in the database at a particular moment in time is called:
Which of the following are the two categories of a database schema?
The physical schema of a database describes:
options: What data is stored and the relationships among the data
How the data is actually stored on the storage media, in files and indexes
The views of individual end users
The security policies of the organization

mcqs.question: The logical schema of a database describes:
options: The file organization used on disk
The entire structure of the database — what data is stored and the relationships among the data
The backup schedule of the database
The network topology of the organization

mcqs.question: In the three-schema architecture, the schema that describes the structure of the whole database for all users is the:
Which level of the three-schema architecture deals with the way data is physically stored?
A subschema is:
options: A description of a portion of the database that is relevant to a particular user or application
A copy of the database schema kept for backup
The schema of the data dictionary itself
A schema that stores only metadata

mcqs.question: Metadata is best defined as:
Which of the following is an example of metadata?
options: The name 'Ali' stored in a student's record
A row inserted into the Student table
The data type and maximum length defined for the column StudentName
The output produced by a SELECT query

mcqs.question: In a DBMS, metadata is stored in:
The data dictionary contains information about all of the following EXCEPT:
options: Names of tables and their columns
Data types and constraints applied on data
The actual data values stored in the tables

mcqs.question: A data dictionary that is automatically updated by the DBMS whenever the database structure changes is called:
When a new table is created using a DDL command, the metadata about that table is recorded by:
options: The DBMS itself, in the system catalog
The application programmer, in a separate file

mcqs.question: Data Administration (DA) is the function responsible for:
options: The overall management of the organization's data resource, including data policies and standards
Installing and configuring the DBMS software
Writing application programs for end users

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a responsibility of Data Administration?
options: Developing data policies, standards and procedures for the organization
Allocating disk space for table files

mcqs.question: Which of the following tasks also belongs to Data Administration?
options: Data planning and resolving data ownership issues
Creating user accounts in the DBMS

mcqs.question: Data Administration differs from Database Administration (DBA) because:
options: DA is a technical function while DBA is a managerial function
DA is a management/policy-level function while DBA is a technical function
There is no difference between the two
DA deals only with hardware while DBA deals only with software

mcqs.question: The person responsible for the overall management of data resources in an organization is known as the:
Which of the following is decided by Data Administration rather than by the DBA?
options: When the database backup will run
Data ownership and data sharing policies across departments
The size of the database buffer cache

mcqs.question: DBA stands for:
Which of the following is a responsibility of the DBA?
options: Managing database security by granting and revoking user privileges

mcqs.question: Ensuring that the database can be restored after a failure is the DBA's responsibility of:
Monitoring the database and improving its response time (performance tuning) is the job of the:
DBA guidelines are best described as:
options: Documented rules and procedures that govern how the database environment is administered
A list of SQL commands for creating tables
The hardware specifications of the database server

mcqs.question: Installing and upgrading the DBMS software is the responsibility of the:
Which of the following is a feature provided by a DBMS?
options: Concurrency control that allows safe multi-user access to the same data

mcqs.question: The DBMS feature that protects the database from unauthorized access is:
Data independence, a feature of the DBMS approach, means that:
options: Data is stored on independent computers
Application programs are not affected by changes in the way data is stored or organized
Users do not need any authorization to access data
Data can never be shared between applications

mcqs.question: A clustered index determines:
options: The order in which tables are created in the database
The physical order in which the data rows of a table are stored
The order of columns in a query result only
The order in which users log in to the system

mcqs.question: How many clustered indexes can be created on a single table?
A table can have only one clustered index because:
options: The DBMS license allows only one index
The data rows can be physically sorted in only one order
A clustered index uses too much disk space
Indexes are created by the operating system

mcqs.question: Which of the following is the correct syntax to create a clustered index IX_Emp on the EmpID column of the Employee table?
options: CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Emp ON Employee (EmpID)
MAKE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Emp IN Employee (EmpID)
ADD CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Emp TO Employee (EmpID)

mcqs.question: A table that does not have a clustered index is called a:
A non-clustered index:
options: Physically reorders the rows of the table
Can be created only once on a table
Is a separate structure that stores the index key values along with pointers to the data rows
Is automatically created for every column

mcqs.question: The main purpose of creating an index on a column is to:
options: Reduce the size of the database
Speed up data retrieval (searching) on that column
Prevent users from updating the table
Encrypt the data in the column

________ is the smallest unit of storage that Oracle Database can use or allocate.

________ stores space logically to create logical objects such as Tables, Indexes and other objects.
A tablespace is a logical storage container for ________.
________ tablespace is used to reduce the load managed by SYSTEM tablespace.

The database can ________ space within an index block.
A/an ________ derives its data from the tables on which it is based.
Identify the correct statement for the foreign key.
options: Foreign key can be a single column as well as a composite key
Foreign key must always be a single column
Foreign key must always be a composite key
Foreign key values can not be repeated

mcqs.question: UNIQUE constraint ensures that all values in the column are ________.
In Entity Relationship diagram, the dotted oval symbol represents ________.
Which attribute is used to specify whether and when ARCn should attempt to rearchive to a failed destination following an error?
A log switch occurs when ________ stops writing to one redo log group and starts writing to another.
To rename redo log members, you must have the ________ system privilege.
The granule size is based on the value of the ________ initialization parameter.
